Top-right SOLKAR: regal male lion with broad stylized SUNBURST MANE CLUMPS separated by deliberate dark wedge-shaped negative spaces; mane is 12–16 large sculpted locks, NOT thousands of fine fur strands, tawny short-coated body, four clear paws, faint muzzle scar. Bottom wide panel GHOR: stylized colossal crocodile, low broad jaw, short splayed legs, large simplified overlapping scute plates, matte muddy ochre/charcoal material with a few oily Black Sap seams. CRITICAL: entire tail is visible from thick base curving gently into a LONG NARROW POINTED TIP with generous empty space beyond; NO blunt amputated/cropped tail. Include full body head-to-tail, tail tip at least 10 percent canvas width from edge.
prompt.action: Neutral complete-body review poses, clear supports, natural anatomical families. Ghor tail is curved forward into panel if needed to keep pointed tip and all body visible. No attacks or gore. Each panel uses editorial scale, not same physical scale.
prompt.scene: Neutral warm gray studio, simple smooth ground, no scenery, consistent soft shadows. Surface detail deliberately simplified into geometry-readable planes and painted color shapes.
prompt.composition: Two top panels panther and lion; one wide bottom crocodile panel. Each subject fully within its panel with generous margin, readable labels. Original premium stylized game art, avoid photoreal texture noise. All visible anatomy stays separate and clear.
prompt.lighting: Soft neutral studio light emphasizes broad sculpted shapes, no wet photoreal glints, no crushed black shadows.
prompt.style: Strongly STYLIZED CINEMATIC 3D game character maquettes with tactile sculpted materials and controlled geometry, mature proportions but simplified surfaces; not realistic wildlife photos, not chibi, no individual fur fibers.
